title: 第二问 PPO 规划：电池动作减少但总费用上升

protocol.time_alignment: interval-end actual labels; 144 ten-minute midnight forecast slots
protocol.execution: fixed midnight plan plus causal intended-action projection

training.hyperparameter_selection: fixed_before_formal_evaluation; env count selected by pilot speed only
training.policy_selection: fixed final update at each causal cutoff; do not select using future evaluation
training.terminal_training_shaping: min_tariff/eta * (final_actual_soc-initial_soc); no reported credit; final evaluation day disabled

formal_implementation_remaining: causal annual runner with signed resumable checkpoints

comparisons.exp005: audit and explicit differing ramp/execution protocol; never silently rank

budget.basis: pilot/benchmark.json short samples, extrapolation only; not convergence evidence

approved_snapshot.authorization_text: 开始，完成之后把分支推送到远程仓库

protocol.exp005_comparison: same numerical inputs and billing; different hard ramp/emergency charging; descriptive only

metric_definitions.cost: sum(price*planned_kwh + 5*price*emergency_kwh); no training penalties or terminal credits
metric_definitions.forecast: frozen exp004 no_season seed42, identical predictions for all RL seeds
metric_definitions.delta_power: P[t]-P[t-1], 48095 differences including midnight; first difference missing; warmup separately
metric_definitions.seed_summary: three independently trained PPO seeds; sample standard deviation ddof=1; not a confidence interval
metric_definitions.training: historical training episode scores, not held-out evaluation or policy optimality guarantees

limitations: fixed-budget, discretized partially observed daily PPO; no optimality/convergence guarantee
daily terminal inventory shaping is absent from actual bills; actor has no final-date indicator
three seeds share the same year and forecasts, not independent annual generalization
cycling/intensity proxies are not calibrated battery lifetime estimates
